items.text: Migepe mag jodolo
Magi e migepe mag yawuot Harun.
Yawuot Harun ne gin: Nadab, Abihu, Eliazar kod Ithamar.
To Nadab kod Abihu notho motelone wuon-gi kendo ne gionge gi yawuowi; omiyo Eliazar kod Ithamar ema ne otiyo kaka jodolo.
Daudi nopogogi e migepe kaluwore kaka nopognigi tich kikonye gi Zadok ma nyakwar Eliazar kod Ahimelek ma nyakwar Ithamar.

Jotelo mangʼeny nonwangʼ e nyikwa Eliazar moloyo nyikwa Ithamar kendo nopog-gi kaluwore gi tichgi. Jotend anywola apar gauchiel nowuok kuom nyikwa, Eliazar to gi jotend anywola aboro nowuok kuom nyikwa Ithamar.
Negipogogi maonge dewo wangʼ ka gigoyo ombulu nikech ne nitie jotelo mag kama ler mar lemo, to gi mag Nyasaye e kind nyikwa Eliazar kod Ithamar.

Jagoro Shemaya wuod Nethanel ma ja-Lawi nondiko nying-gi e nyim ruoth, to gi jotelo, ne gin Zadok jadolo, Ahimelek wuod Abiathar kod jotend anywola mag jodolo kod mag jo-Lawi ka gikawo ngʼato achiel koa e anywola mar Eliazar, to machielo koa e anywola mar Ithamar.
Ombulu mokwongo nolwar ne Jehoyarib,
to mar ariyo ne Jedaya,
mar adek ne Harim,
to mar angʼwen ne Seorim,
mar abich ne Malkija,
to mar auchiel ne Mijamin,
mar abiriyo ne Hakoz,
to mar aboro ne Abija,
mar ochiko ne Jeshua,
to mar apar ne Shekania,
mar apar gachiel ne Eliashib,
to mar apar gariyo ne Jakim,
mar apar gadek ne Hupa,
to mar apar gangʼwen ne Jeshebeab,
mar apar gabich ne Bilga,
to mar apar gauchiel ne Imer,
mar apar gabiriyo ne Hezir,
to mar apar gaboro ne Hapizez,
mar apar gochiko ne Pethahia,
to mar piero ariyo ne Jehezkel,
mar piero ariyo gachiel ne Jakin,
to mar piero ariyo gariyo ne Gamul,
mar piero ariyo gadek ne Delaya
to mar piero ariyo gangʼwen ne Mazia.
Ma e kaka nochan-gi mondo giti kane gidonjo e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kaluwore gi chike mane Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel nochiko Harun kwargi.
Joka Lawi mamoko
Nyikwa Lawi mamoko e magi:
Koa kuom yawuot Amram noyier Shubael;
koa kuom yawuot Shubael noyier Jedeya.
Koa kuom yawuot Rehabia noyier Ishia mokwongo.
Koa kuom Izhar noyier Shelomoth;
koa kuom yawuot Shelomoth noyier Jahath.
Yawuot Hebron mane oyier ne gin:
Jeria mokwongo, mar ariyo Amaria, mar adek Jahaziel kod mar angʼwen Jekameam.
Wuod Uziel mane oyier ne en, Mika,
to kuom yawuot Mika noyier Shamir.
Owadgi Mika mane oyier ne en Ishia,
to kuom yawuot Ishia noyier Zekaria.
Yawuot Merari mane oyier ne gin: Mali kod Mushi.
To kuom yawuot Jazia noyier Beno.
Kuom yawuot Merari:
noyier Jazia: to kuom yawuot Jazia noyier Beno, Shoham, Zakur kod Ibri.
Koa kuom Mali noyier Eliazar mane ok onywolo yawuowi.
Koa kuom Kish, noyier wuod Kish miluongo ni Jeramel.
Koa kuom yawuot Mushi noyier Mali, Eder kod Jerimoth.
Magi e jo-Lawi mane oyier kaluwore gi anywolagi.

Gin bende negigoyo ombulu mana kaka jowetegi ma nyikwa Harun notimo e nyim Ruoth Daudi kod Zadok, Ahimelek kaachiel gi jotelo mag anywola mag jodolo kod jo-Lawi. Jomadongo notimnegi mana machalre gi jomatindo.

items.text: Jower
Daudi kaachiel gi jotend jolweny noyiero yawuot Asaf mamoko gi yawuot Heman gi yawuot Jeduthun ne tich koro wach ka gigoyo nyatiti, gi orutu kod ongengʼo. Ma e chenro mar jogo kaka negitiyo:
Koa kuom yawuot Asaf noyier:
Zakur, Josef, Nethania kod Asarela. Yawuot Asaf notelnigi gi Asaf mane jakor wach ni ruoth.
Koa kuom yawuot Jeduthun noyier:
Gedalia gi Zeri gi Jeshaya gi Shimei gi Hashabia kod Matithia. Giduto ne gin ji auchiel kendo notelnegi kod wuon-gi Jeduthun mane koro ka goyone Jehova Nyasaye erokamano kendo pake gi nyatiti.
Koa kuom yawuot Heman noyier:
Bukia, Matania, Uziel, Shubael kod Jerimoth, bende noyier Hanania, Hanani, Eliatha, Gidalti kod Romamti-Ezer, bangʼe noyier Joshbekasha, Malothi, Hothir, kod Mahazioth.
Magi duto ne gin yawuot Heman jakor wach ne ruoth mane Nyasaye omiye kaluwore gi singruok ni nobiro tingʼe malo. Nyasaye nomiyo Heman yawuowi apar gangʼwen kod nyiri adek.
Jogi duto notelnegi gi wuonegi e tijgi mar goyo thum e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, ka gitiyo e od Nyasaye kuom goyo ongengʼo, orutu kod nyatiti.
Asaf, Jeduthun, kod Heman to notelonegi kod ruoth.
Jogo duto kaachiel gi wedegi ne nigi tiegruok kod lony kuom goyo thum ne Jehova Nyasaye, giduto ne gin ji mia ariyo gi piero aboro gaboro.
Negipogo tijgi ka gigoyo ombulu, jomatindo gi jomadongo, jopuonj gi joma ipuonjo machalre.
Pok mokwongo mar Asaf nodhine Josef gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
Pok mar ariyo ne mar Gedalia gi wedene kod yawuote, giduto ji apar gariyo,
Pok mar adek ne mar Zakur gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
Pok mar angʼwen ne mar Izri gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
Pok mar abich ne mar Nethania gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
Pok mar auchiel ne mar Bukia gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
Pok mar abiriyo ne mar Jesarela gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
Pok mar aboro ne mar Jeshaya gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
Pok mar ochiko ne mar Matania gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
Pok mar apar ne mar Shimei gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
Pok mar apar gachiel ne mar Azarel gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
Pok mar apar gariyo ne mar Hashabia gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
Pok mar apar gadek ne mar Shubael gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,
Pok mar apar gangʼwen ne mar Matithia gi yawuote kod wedene, giduto ji apar gariyo,

items.text: Jorit rangeye
Magi e migepe mag jorit rangeye:
Koa kuom joka Kora,
noyier Meshelemia wuod Kore, ma en achiel kuom yawuot Asaf.
Meshelemia ne nigi yawuowi,
wuowi makayo ne en Zekaria, mar ariyo ne en Jediael,
mar adek ne en Zebadia, mar angʼwen ne en Jathniel,
mar abich ne en Elam, mar auchiel ne en Jehohanan,
to mar abiriyo ne en Eliehoenai.
Obed-Edom bende Nyasaye nogwedho gi yawuowi,
wuowi makayo ne en Shemaya, mar ariyo ne en Jehozabad,
mar adek ne en Joa, mar angʼwen ne en Sakar,
mar abich ne en Nethanel,
mar auchiel ne en Amiel,
mar abiriyo ne en Isakar, to mar aboro ne en Peulethai.
Nimar Nyasaye nosegwedho Obed-Edom.
Wuode ma Shemaya bende nonywolo yawuowi mane gin jotend dhood wuon-gi nikech ne gin joma olony.
Yawuot Shemaya ne gin,
Othni, Refael, Obed kod Elzabad;
Elihu kod Semakia ma wedene bende ne joma niginyalo.
Magi duto ne gin nyikwa Obed-Edom. Gin kaachiel gi yawuotgi to gi wedegi ne gin joma niginyalo kendo maroteke kuom tich. Koriw nyikwa Obed-Edom duto to ne gin ji piero auchiel gariyo.
Meshelemia ne nigi yawuowi kod wedene, giduto ne gin ji apar gaboro man-gi nyalo.
Hosa ja-Merari ne nigi yawuowi,
mokwongo Shimri (kata obedo ni ne ok en wuode makayo, wuon-gi noyiere mokwongo),
mar ariyo ne en Hilkia, mar adek ne en Tabalia,
to mar angʼwen ne en Zekaria.
Yawuot Hosa kod wedene giduto ne gin ji apar gadek.
Migepegi mag jorit rangeye kokadho kuom jotendgi madongo ne nigi pok mar tiyo ei hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye mana kaka wedegi bende notimo.
Nogo ombulu kaluwore gi anywolagi, jomatindo gi jomadongo machalre mondo oyud jorit rangeye.
Ombulu mar Rangach ma yo Wuok Chiengʼ nolwar ne Shelemia.
Nogo ombulu ne wuode Zekaria, ma jangʼad bura mariek kendo noyudo Rangach ma yo Nyandwat.
Ombulu mar Rangach ma yo Milambo nolwar ne Obed-Edom, to ombulu mar od keno nolwar ne yawuote.
Ombulu mar Rangach ma yo Podho Chiengʼ to gi rangach miluongo ni Shaleketh man e yo mamalo nolwar ne Shupim kod Hosa.
Arita duto noket machalre.
Pile ka pile ne nitiere jo-Lawi auchiel marito rangach ma yo wuok chiengʼ,
angʼwen e rangach ma yo nyandwat,
angʼwen rangach ma yo milambo,
to gi ariyo ariyo mane rito od keno.
Kuom laru mantie yo podho chiengʼ, angʼwen ne rito yo michopogo e laru to ariyo ne rito laruno.
Magi e migepe mag jorit rangeye mane gin nyikwa Kora kod Merari.
Jokeno kod jotelo mamoko
To jowetegi moko ma jo-Lawi, kotelnegi gi Ahija, ne gin jorit kuonde keno mag od Nyasaye kod kuonde mikanoe gik mowal.
Nyikwa Ladan mane gin joka Gershon ma anywola mar Ladan kendo mane jotelo mag dhout Ladan ja-Gershon ne gin Jehiel,
yawuot Jehiel ne gin Zetham gi owadgi ma Joel. Gin ema ne gichungʼne keno mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
Koa kuom jo-Amram, gi joka Izhar gi joka Hebron kod joka Uziel noyier,
Shubael ma nyakwar Gershom wuod Musa mane jatelo manorito kuonde keno.
To wedene ma joka Eliezer noyier yawuote ma gin Rehabia, Jeshaya, Joram, Zikri kod Shelomith.
Shelomith gi wedene to nochungʼne keno duto mag gik mane Ruoth Daudi owalo gi jotend dhoudi mane gin jotend jolweny alufe kod jotend jolweny miche to gi jotend jolweny mamoko.
Moko kuom gik mane ope e lweny nowal ne tij loso hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.
Bende gik moko duto manowal gi Samuel janen kod Saulo wuod Kish, Abner wuod Ner kod Joab wuod Zeruya kaachiel gi gik mamoko duto manowal norit gi Shelomith kod wedene.
Kuom joka Izhar
noyier Kenania kod yawuote manomi tije oko mar hekalu kaka jotelo kendo jongʼad bura e piny Israel.
Kuom joka Hebron
noyier Hashabia kod wedene. Ne gin ji alufu achiel mia abiriyo motegno, mane rito jo-Israel modak yo podho chiengʼ mar Jordan ka girito tije duto mag Jehova Nyasaye kendo ka gitiyone ruoth.
Kuom joka Hebron, Jeria ema ne jatendgi kaluwore gi nonro mar anywolagi.
E higa mar piero angʼwen mar loch Daudi nonon ndiko kendo noyud ni joma olony kuom nyikwa Hebron ne oa Jazer e piny Gilead.

Jeria ne nigi wedene alufu ariyo mia abiriyo mane gin joma olony kendo jotend anywola, omiyo Ruoth Daudi noketogi jotend jo-Reuben, jo-Gad kod nus dhood jo-Manase e yore duto mag tich Nyasaye to gi tije mag ruoth.

items.text: Migepe mag jolweny

Ma e chenro mar nying jo-Israel ma jotend anywola, jotend jolweny alufe kod jolweny miche to gi jotendgi; mane tiyone ruoth kaluwore kod tije duto mag migepe mag jolweny mane ni e tich dwe ka dwe kuom higa ngima. Migawo ka migawo notingʼo ji alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000).
Jatend migawo mokwongo mane tiyo e dwe mokwongo ne en Jashobeam wuod Zabdiel. Ne nitiere ji alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000) e migape.
Ne en nyakwar Perez kendo en ema ne en jatelo maduongʼ motelone jotend lweny mag dwe mokwongo.
Jatelo e migawo mar dwe mar ariyo ne en Dodai ja-Ahohi, Mikloth ne jatend migape. Ne nitiere ji alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000) e migape.
Jatend jolweny mar adek, e dwe mar adek ne en Benaya wuod Jehoyada ma jadolo. Ne en jatelo maduongʼ kendo notelo ne jolweny alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000) e migape.
Ma e Benaya mane achiel kuom thuondi piero adek madongo kendo en ema notelonegi. Wuode miluongo ni Amizabad notelo ne migape.
Jatelo mar angʼwen, e dwe mar angʼwen ne en Asahel owadgi Joab. Bangʼe Zebadia wuode nokawo kare. Ne nitiere ji alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000) e migape.
Jatelo mar abich e dwe mar abich ne en Shamhuth ma ja-Izra. Ne nitiere ji alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000) e migape.
Jatelo mar auchiel, e dwe mar auchiel ne en Ira wuod Ikesh ja-Tekoi. Ne nitiere ji alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000) e migape.
Jatelo mar abiriyo, e dwe mar abiriyo ne en Helez ja-Pelon ma ja-Efraim. Ne nitiere ji alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000) e migape.
Jatelo mar aboro, e dwe mar aboro ne en Sibekai ja-Hushath ma ja-Zera. Ne nitiere ji alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000) e migape.
Jatelo mar ochiko, e dwe mar ochiko ne en Abiezer ja-Anathoth ma ja-Benjamin. Ne nitiere ji alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000) e migape.
Jatelo mar apar, e dwe mar apar ne en Maharai ja-Netofath ma ja-Zera. Ne nitiere ji alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000) e migape.
Jatelo mar apar gachiel, e dwe mar apar gachiel ne en Benaya ja-Pirathon ma ja-Efraim. Ne nitiere ji alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000) e migape.
Jatelo mar apar gariyo, e dwe mar apar gariyo ne en Heldai ja-Netofath koa e anywola mar Othniel. Ne nitiere ji alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen (24,000) e migape.
Jotend dhoudi
Jotend dhout Israel ne gin:
koa kuom jo-Reuben: Eliezer wuod Zikri notelonegi,
koa kuom jo-Simeon: Shefatia wuod Maaka notelonegi;
koa kuom jo-Lawi notelnigi gi Hashabia wuod Kemuel;
koa kuom joka Harun: Zadok notelonegi;
koa kuom jo-Juda: Elihu owadgi Daudi notelonegi;
koa kuom jo-Isakar: Omri wuod Mikael notelonegi;
koa kuom jo-Zebulun: Ishmaya wuod Obadia notelonegi;
koa kuom jo-Naftali: Jerimoth wuod Azriel notelonegi;
koa kuom jo-Efraim: Hoshea wuod Azazia notelonegi;
koa kuom nus mar dhood jo-Manase: Joel wuod Pedaya notelonegi;
koa kuom nus machielo mar jo-Manase mane ni e piny Gilead: Ido wuod Zekaria notelonegi;
koa kuom jo-Benjamin: Jasiel wuod Abner notelonegi;
koa kuom jo-Dan: Azarel wuod Jeroham notelonegi.
Magi ema ne jotelo mane otelo ne dhout Israel.
Daudi ne ok okawo kwan ji ma jo-higni piero ariyo, kata matin ne mano nikech Jehova Nyasaye ne osesingore ni nomi jo-Israel bed mangʼeny mana ka sulwe manie kor polo.
Joab wuod Zeruya nochako kwano ji, to ne ok otieko. Kwenono nokelo mirimb Nyasaye kuom jo-Israel, omiyo ne ok ondik kwenono e kitap Weche mag Ndalo mag loch Ruoth Daudi.
Jodong ruoth
Azmaveth wuod Adiel ne jarit kuonde keno mar ruoth.
Jonathan wuod Uzia ne rito kuonde mag keno mag gwenge molwore, e mier madongo kod matindo, kendo e miech lweny mochiel gi ohinga.
Ezri wuod Kelub ne rito jotich mane tiyo e puodho.
Shimei ja-Rama to ne orito puothe mzabibu.
Zabdi ja-Shifmi to norito olemb mzabibu e kar loso divai.
Baal-Hanan ja-Geder to norito yiend zeituni gi yiende ngʼowu mane ni e bwo gode e yo podho chiengʼ,
Joash nochungʼne kano mo zeituni.
Shitrai ja-Sharon nochungʼne kweth mag dhok makwayo Sharon.
Shafat wuod Aldai to ne ochungʼ ne kweth dhok manie holo.
Obil ja-Ishmael to nochungʼne ngamia,
Jedeya ma ja-Meronoth to nochungʼne punde.
Jaziz ja-Hagri nochungʼne kweth rombe.
Magi duto ne jotelo mane orito mwandu mag Ruoth Daudi.
Jonathan, owadgi wuon Daudi ne en jangʼad rieko, ngʼat man-gi paro matut, kendo jagoro.
Jehiel wuod Hakmon norito yawuot ruoth.
Ahithofel ne en jangʼad rieko ne ruoth.
Hushai ja-Arki to ne en osiep ruoth.
(Jehoyada wuod Benaya kod Abiathar nokawo kar Ahithofel.)
Joab to ne jatend jolweny.

items.text: Daudi ochano gero hekalu

Daudi noluongo jotend Israel duto mondo ochokre Jerusalem. Noluongo jotend dhoudi gi jotend migepe mag jotich ruoth, jotelo morito migepe mag jolweny alufe gi migepe mag jolweny miche, to gi jotelo morito mwandu duto kod jamni mag ruoth gi mag yawuote kaachiel gi jotelo matiyo e dala ruoth, joma roteke to gi jolweny mathuondi.

Eka Ruoth Daudi nochungo kar tiende mowacho niya, "Winjauru jowetena kendo jothurwa. Ne achano e chunya mondo ager ot kaka kar yweyo mar Sandug Singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye mondo obed raten mar tiend Nyasachwa kendo ne an gi chenro mar gere.
To Nyasaye nowachona ni, 'Ok iniger ot miluonge Nyinga nikech in jalweny kendo isechwero remo.'

"Kata kamano Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel noyiera kuom anywolana mondo abed ruodh Israel manyaka chiengʼ. Noyiero Juda jatelo, to koa e dhood Juda noyiero anywolana, to kuom yawuot wuora duto, notimo ngʼwono mondo oketa ruodh Israel duto.
To kuom yawuota duto ma bende Jehova Nyasaye osemiya mangʼeny, noyiero wuoda Solomon mondo obedi e kom loch mar pinyruodh Jehova Nyasaye e Israel.
Nowachona niya, Wuodi Solomon e ngʼat manogerna ot gi laru mare nikech aseyiere mondo odok wuoda kendo anabed wuon-gi.
Ka orito chikena gi buchena ma ok obaro mana kaka iritogi sani, to anagur lochne nyaka chiengʼ.

"Omiyo achikou e nyim Israel duto kendo e nyim chokruok mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo ka Nyasachwa wacho kama: Beduru motangʼ mondo ulu chike duto mag Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu mondo omi piny maberni osik maru kendo uchiwe kaka girkeni ne nyikwau nyaka chiengʼ.

"To in wuoda Solomon, par Nyasach wuonu kendo ichiwri mondo itine gi chunyi duto kendo imiye paroni duto nikech Jehova Nyasaye nono chuny ji duto kendo ongʼeyo paro duto mopondo. Kidware, to iniyude, to kiweye, to enojwangʼi nyaka chiengʼ.
Emomiyo par malongʼo nikech Jehova Nyasaye oseyieri mondo igerne ot kaka kama ler mar lemo. Bed motegno kendo itim tich."
Bangʼe Daudi nonyiso wuode Solomon kit gedo mar agoch hekalu, kaka onego gere, kuondege mag keno, utege mamalo, agolnige maiye kod kar timo misango.

Ne omiye kit gedo duto mag laru mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye to gi udi molwore kod mago mag keno mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo kuonde keno mag gik mopwodhi mana kaka Roho mar Nyasaye noketo e pache.
Bende nomiye chike mag migepe mag jodolo kod jo-Lawi to gi tije duto mag hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kaachiel gi gik moko duto mitiyogo e iye.
Bende nonyise pek mar dhahabu molosgo gige dhahabu monego tigo e tije mopogore opogore, to gi pek mar fedha molosgo gige fedha monego tigo tije mopogore opogore kaka:

pek mar rachungi mag teyni kod techegi molos gi dhahabu, kaachiel gi pek mar rachungi mar taya ka taya gi techene, pek fedha mar rachungi mar taya ka taya gi techene molos kod fedha mana kaka moro ka moro owinjore gi tije;
pek mar dhahabu mar mesa ka mesa miketoe makati mopwodhi kaachiel gi pek mar fedha mag mesni molos gi fedha;
pek mar dhahabu maler milosogo uma, bakunde mag kiro pi kod njage; pek mar dhahabu mar tawo ka tawo molos gi dhahabu kod pek mar fedha mar tawo ka tawo molos gi fedha;

kod pek dhahabu mopwodhi molosgo kendo mar misango miwangʼoe ubani. Bende nonyise kaka onego olos gach lweny, ma en kerubi molos gi dhahabu moyaro bwombegi kendo oumo Sandug Singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye.
Daudi nowacho niya, "Magi duto manie ndiko ne ayudo kuom lwet Jehova Nyasaye mane ni kuoma, kendo nomiya winjo matut kuom chenro mar gedo."

Bangʼe Daudi nowachone Solomon niya, "Bed motegno kendo gichir kendo tim tijni. Kik ibed maluor kendo kik chunyi nyosre nikech Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasacha nobed kodi. Ok enojwangʼi bende ok noweyi nyaka itiek tije mag hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye."

Migepe mag jodolo kod jo-Lawi oseikore ne tije duto mag hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, kendo joma ochiwore molony e tije mopogore opogore oikore konyi e tije duto. Jotelo kod ji duto nowinj weche duto miwacho.

items.text: Chiwo mag hekalu

Eka Ruoth Daudi nowacho ni chokruok duto niya, "Solomon wuoda ma Nyasaye oseyiero pod en rawera man-gi lony matin. To tijni en tich maduongʼ nikech ot malichni ok en mar dhano to en mar Jehova Nyasaye.

Kuom mwandu duto ma aseiko ne gero hekalu mar Nyasacha ma gin dhahabu kuom tije madwaro dhahabu, gi fedha kuom tije mag fedha, gi mula kuom tije mag mula, gi nyinyo kuom tije mag nyinyo, kaachiel gi yiende kuom tije mag yiende kod oniks milosogo ot, gi kite ma kitgi opogore opogore gi kite duto mabeyo kod kite mag ombo. Magi duto aseiko mangʼeny.
Ewi mago duto ma asechiwo ne hekalu mar Nyasacha achako agolo mwanduna awuon mag dhahabu kod mag fedha ne hekalu mar Nyasacha. To bende asechiwo moloyo mago ne hekalu malerni gik machalo kaka:
dhahabu moa Ofir ma pekne romo kilo alufu mia achiel, fedha mopwodhi ma pekne romo kilo alufu piero ariyo gangʼwen mondo obawgo kor udi,
mago notigo tije madwaro dhahabu kod fedha kod tije duto ma jotich molony dwaro timo. To koro ere ngʼat moyie mondo ochiwre ne Jehova Nyasaye kawuono?"
Eka jotend anywola gi jotelo mag dhout Israel, gi jotend migepe mag jolweny alufe to gi jotend migepe mag jolweny miche kaachiel gi jotelo mochungʼne tije ruoth nochiwore mamor.

Negichiwore ne tich mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye ka gigolo dhahabu ma pekne romo kilo alufu mia achiel gi piero ochiko kod machielo ma pekne romo kilo piero aboro gangʼwen, gi fedha ma pekne romo kilo alufu mia adek gi piero abiriyo gabich kod mula ma pekne romo kilo alufu mia auchiel gi piero abiriyo gabich kaachiel gi nyinyo ma pekne romo kilo gana adek, alufu mia abiriyo gi piero abich.
Bende joma ne ni kod kite ma nengogi tek nochiwogi e kar keno mar hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye ka jaritgi en Jehiel ja-Gershon.
Ji duto ne mor gi ilo kuom chiwo mar jotendgi nikech negichiwo gi mor kendo gi chuny achiel ni Jehova Nyasaye. Ruoth Daudi bende nomor ahinya.
Lemo mar Daudi
Daudi nopako Jehova Nyasaye e nyim riwruok mar ji duto kowacho niya,
"Yaye Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach kwarwa Israel,
duongʼ odogni ndalo duto,
manyaka chiengʼ.
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, duongʼ kod teko,
pak gi loch kod ber odogni,
nimar gik moko duto manie polo gi piny gin magi.
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, pinyruoth en mari
kendo omiyi duongʼ moloyo gik moko duto.
Mwandu gi duongʼ aa kuomi;

"An to an ngʼa, kata joga to gin ngʼa gini, mamiyo nyaka wachiw gi chuny achiel ka ma? Gik moko duto aa kuomi, kendo wasemiyi mana gima oa e lweti
Wan jodak kendo joma welo e nyim wangʼi, mana kaka kwerewa nobet. Ndalowa e piny ka chalo gi tipo, kendo waonge geno.
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa, kuom gigi duto ma wasechiwo ne geroni hekalu ne Nyingi Maler, oa e lweti, kendo giduto gin magi.
Angʼeyo, Nyasacha, ni inono chuny ji kendo imor gi ngʼama timbene beyo. Asechiwo gigi duto gimor kod chuny makare. To bende aseneno kuom mor ma jogi man ka osechiworenigo.
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach kwerewa Ibrahim, Isaka kod Israel, mad herani osiki ei chuny jogi ndalo duto kendo imi chunygi osik kuomi.
Kony Solomon wuoda osik kogeno kuomi gi chunye duto mondo orit chikeni gi dwaroni kod gima iwacho kendo mondo otim gik moko duto kaluwore gi chenro mar gedo malichni ma asechiworane."

Bangʼe Daudi nowachone chokruok duto niya, "Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachu." Omiyo giduto negipako Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach kweregi, negikulore piny auma kendo ginindo piny e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kendo e nyim ruoth Daudi.
Solomon obedo ruoth

Kinyne negitimone Jehova Nyasaye misango kendo negichiwone misengini miwangʼo pep mag rwedhi alufu achiel gi imbe alufu achiel to gi nyiimbe alufu achiel kaachiel gi misango miolo piny to gi misengini mamoko mangʼeny ne jo-Israel duto.
Negichiemo kendo metho gimor maduongʼ odiechiengno e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
Bangʼe negichako giketo Solomon wuod Daudi kaka ruoth, kendo ne giwire gi mo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye mondo obed ruoth, to Zadok, to nowir kaka jadolo.
Omiyo Solomon nobedo e kom loch Jehova Nyasaye kaka ruoth kar Daudi wuon mare. Ne en gi gweth kendo jo-Israel nomiye luor.
Jotelo kod thuondi madongo kaachiel gi yawuot Ruoth Daudi nochiwore moyie bedo e bwo loch Ruoth Solomon.
Jehova Nyasaye notingʼo Solomon malo e nyim jo-Israel kendo nomiye duongʼ moloyo ruodhi duto mane osebedo e Israel motelone.
Tho mar Daudi
Daudi wuod Jesse ne ruoth mar jo-Israel duto.
Nobedo ruodh Israel duto higni piero angʼwen, higni abiriyo ne en Hebron, to higni piero adek gadek ne en Jerusalem.
Nodak e ngima maber ka en-gi mwandu kod duongʼ, bangʼe notho ka hike noniangʼ moloyo. Wuode ma Solomon nobedo ruoth kare.
Kaluwore gi gik moko mane Daudi otimo chakre kinde mane en ruoth nyaka giko; ondikgi e kitepe mag jonabi Samuel, Nathan kod Gad,
kaachiel gi weche mamoko mag lochne kod teko, to gi gik moko mane olwore gi jo-Israel kod loch jopinje mamoko.
